subject: Re: Greenleaf workshop — finalizing speaker latches, pre-read gating, and arrival windows
body:
From: Avery Thompson <avery.thompson@greenleaf.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: samir.patel@greenleaf.com
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Greenleaf workshop — initial speaker confirmation and pre-read gating

Evelyn / Marissa —

Thanks again for the outline. We’re locking the leadership slate for the Oct 12 onsite and need a quick pass on who is actually "locked" vs. "backup." Two asks from our side before we circulate the pre-read to the exec committee:

- Confirm which speakers are final (we need names to populate the headshots page).
- Confirm pre-read artifact types (one-pager + 10–12 slide deck acceptable?), and whether you can provide a consolidated PDF by Oct 5.

Attached is our internal expectation doc — it’s light. Also noted travel arrival windows below; we’d like speakers there by 3pm on Oct 11 for the speaker dinner rehearsal.

Best,
Avery
Avery Thompson
Director, Strategic Programs
Greenleaf Therapeutics

---

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
To: Avery Thompson <avery.thompson@greenleaf.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@greenleaf.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenleaf workshop — initial speaker confirmation and pre-read gating

Avery — thanks for the clarity. Quick responses inline and next steps below.

1) Locked speakers (we will populate headshots):
   - Sarah Kim (Customer Success) — locked
   - Tom Rivers (CTO) — locked
   - Ana Gomez (Product) — backup (we’ll confirm by Oct 1)

2) Pre-read format: 1x one-page exec summary + 8–10 slide deck recommended. We’ll combine into a single PDF for circulation.

Action items we’ll own:
- Ben will merge slides and export the consolidated PDF (target Oct 4).
- Marissa will own the headshot and short bio collection (deadline Oct 1).
- Sean will own run-of-show timing and speaker buffer slots (draft by Oct 2).

Ben / Marissa / Sean — please flag if any of the dates below are infeasible.

Evelyn

---

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Avery Thompson <avery.thompson@greenleaf.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenleaf workshop — slide merge + speaker timings

Attaching Speaker_Matrix_R02.xlsx and my working deck stub. I can take the final slide decks and produce the single PDF by Oct 4; would prefer final slide drops by Oct 2 COB so I have padding for visual QA.

Note on timings: we should cap external exec presentations at 12 minutes + 3 minutes for live Q; internal Redwoods can be 10+2 to keep the flow. If Greenleaf wants longer case studies we should mark those as deep-dive breakout sessions.

Attachments: Speaker_Matrix_R02.xlsx, Ben_MergeStub.pptx (referenced)

Ben
Senior Program Producer
Redwood Inference

---

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Cc: Avery Thompson <avery.thompson@greenleaf.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: headshots + bios and a single pre-read

Quick update: reaching out to Sarah and Tom for headshots now. For Ana (backup) I’ve drafted a short fallback note requesting a 2-paragraph bio and a slide if she confirms.

Also — two content asks for Greenleaf:
- Can you provide one short metric callout for each speaker (e.g., "reduced MTTR by 27%") so we can craft the speaker pages?
- If you have a preferred pronouncement for the rehearsal (e.g., "open with scenario A"), drop that into the speaker notes so we can brief the AV team.

Marissa

---

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Avery Thompson <avery.thompson@greenleaf.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@greenleaf.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: run of show draft + arrival windows

Attached is ROG_RunOfShow_v2.docx — I set the speaker buffer to 6 minutes between slots and reserved 30 minutes at the end of Day 0 (Oct 11) for speaker dinner rehearsal. Travel window notes: arrivals between 1pm–4pm Oct 11 preferred for AV check; any arrivals earlier than 11am should route through the Greenleaf concierge for early check-in.

Per previous thread, we have final slide drop deadline Oct 2 COB. If anyone anticipates slippage, shout now — otherwise I’ll publish the ROG and push the calendar invites to the confirmed speakers on Oct 3.

Sean
Senior Events Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: ROG_RunOfShow_v2.docx

---

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@greenleaf.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Avery Thompson <avery.thompson@greenleaf.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 17:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: run of show draft + arrival windows

Thanks team — this looks good. Two small asks: can the rehearsal be scheduled at 6:30pm (vs. 7pm) on Oct 11 to accommodate an exec dinner that starts at 8pm? Also can you confirm whether the consolidated pre-read PDF will include a cover letter from our CEO (we'll provide text)?

If those fit, Greenleaf will circulate to the exec committee on Oct 6.

Samir
VP, Customer Success
Greenleaf Therapeutics

---

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@greenleaf.com>, Avery Thompson <avery.thompson@greenleaf.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 17:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: run of show draft + arrival windows

Samir — noted and accepted.
- Rehearsal: we’ll move the speaker rehearsal to 6:30pm Oct 11 and confirm AV call at 3pm that day.
- Pre-read: yes — we will include the CEO cover letter as the prefatory page; please send the text by Oct 4 so Ben can include it in the consolidated PDF.

I’ll publish the revised run-of-show and speaker matrix by Oct 3 after Ben’s merge.

Evelyn
Director, Enterprise Programs
Redwood Inference

[Attachments referenced: Greenleaf_Pre-read_v1.pdf (external sample), Speaker_Matrix_R02.xlsx (internal), ROG_RunOfShow_v2.docx (internal)]
